suggestedWebsiteCopy.currentLine: Founding Engineer at HeyTheo and Vediq · Chandigarh, India
about: I’ve been the person behind the app, the backend, the infrastructure, and the release. At HeyTheo, that started with an empty repository and a team of one.

My AI work lives inside products: tool interfaces that let agents act, retrieval that gives them context, and the services around them. Before that, I helped build MUZEE.AI’s video editing platform, starting with models that add sound to silent footage.
I use LLMs for work they can usefully carry forward. The product decisions, engineering judgment, and responsibility for what ships stay with me.
